description_text_verbatim: Enjoy next-level lightness when attaching Coral Slide Pro’s ultra-lightweight carrier to your Fame or Fame Cabin pushchair.
faq_text_verbatim: The Coral Slide Pro Carrier adapter allows you to create a unique combination of the Coral Slide Pro soft carrier, and the Fame OR Fame Cabin pushchair. The adapter clicks directly onto the Fame Cabin frame or can be installed on the Fame by attaching the included adapter-extension set.
findings: Fame Cabin: adapter 'clicks directly onto the Fame Cabin frame' -> unconditional pair Coral Slide Pro x Fame Cabin.

Fame: only 'by attaching the included adapter-extension set' -> conditional pair (extension is part of the delivered set; the seed has an unknown extension article '?|None' -> the extension's own MPN/SKU must come from the manual or box contents, not be guessed).
'Fame' and 'Fame Cabin' are both named separately in the same sentence; there is no transfer between them.
'Coral 360' does not occur anywhere on the page (0 hits) -> the two absent_from_list claims (Coral 360 x Fame Cabin / Fame) rest on absence only and can never become EXCLUDED from this page.
